messages:
Mina: Starting a quick kickoff for a joint connector launch: Snowflake Delta Share + Databricks Unity + Qdrant. Aim: 2-week fast path for a certified connector listing and SI playbook.
Ethan: Thanks Mina. Key constraints: partner logo approvals, Delta Share consumer ACLs, and Qdrant schema alignment. Any embargo windows?
Mina: Marketing requests 10 business days lead if we plan a co-announcement. Proposed soft-go: 2025-03-18, embargo lock 2025-03-06.
Priya: On the connector side I need a reproducible sample table and a small ETL that shows column-filtering before vectorization. I'll produce a masked 5k-row sample. ETA 48h.
Sam: Infra asks: can we run a perf soak on Aurora and DGX pools for quantized model paths? Need to verify latency p95 at 500 qps. I'll schedule a 48h soak after CI.
Mina: Owners: connector=Priya, infra=Sam, marketing=Mina, legal=Jules. Legal: can you confirm EU residency and contract notes by EOD Fri?
Partner Bot: Logo approval requested for Snowflake and Qdrant at 2025-02-12T11:00Z. Status: pending.
Jules (Legal): Will run residency check and NDA/COI review, delivery by 2025-02-14 EOD.
Ethan: Decision: combined listing vs certified-badge. Ops prefers badge (faster), partner PMs sometimes prefer combined for co-marketing. Suggest start with badge and iterate.
Priya: CI snippet we'll add to the repo README:
```
name: ci-integration
jobs:
  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: python tests/delta_to_qdrant.py --sample-bucket ${{ secrets.SAMPLE_BUCKET }}
```
Sam: InfraBot scheduling: connectors/cicd/delta-qdrant-verify. Will post artifacts to build-archive on failure.
Mina: Marketing note: 2-min demo + one-pager. Avoid numeric latency claims until soak completes. Also need partner logo approvals before co-branded assets.
Ethan: SI handoff: propose a 60m enablement + a short troubleshooting cheatsheet. Who will draft? Priya?
Priya: I can draft the cheatsheet and quickstart repo examples. ETA 3 days.
Sam: FW note: Aurora nodes require firmware 2.0+ for our batching kernel stability. I'll validate and post matrix.
Mina: Risks logged: EU residency, firmware mismatch, revenue share if combined listing. I'll create the triage card and loop partner PMs after legal signoff.
Partner Bot: Action created: "connector-marketplace-triage" assigned to Mina, due 2025-02-20.
Jules (Legal): Added COI checklist item for combined listings.
Sam: I'll kick off the CI once sample data is uploaded. Expect initial pass ~24h after upload.
Mina: Thanks team. Quick sync Friday 09:00 PT.
Ethan: End of thread.
